_note: v2.4 plan 01 guidance (D7, X7), no backend. Sun-ruins authors guidance on cp1 and cp-4a and none on cp2. The active checkpoint's guidance must sit in story_orchestrator_guidance (system, depth 4) on load and on /cp activate, be composed by the next-turn preview, be withheld while a quiet run is open and restored at its end, and be cleared on a guidance-less checkpoint. RED on 931add3/eb50a00: nothing injects guidance, so step 3 fails first.
